searchText: Lighthouse fix for the penalty bug can be found in this PR: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/1166 Thanks all (and particularly <@!203220829473996800> ) for the invaluable debugging info. I'm keen to get into testing all this more thoroughly! Cool. I'll keep the six schlesi bootnodes (lh, prysm, teku) around for another week. But will propose a new testnet https://github.com/goerli/schlesi/commit/5a6d32458f3d76001161ac2d3b0a2f41924e1085 Yay! I can pronounce this one. 🙂 Nice, which subway station is that? 😉 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wittenbergplatz_(Berlin_U-Bahn) 😉 > https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wittenbergplatz_(Berlin_U-Bahn) 😉 <@!557201004060213248> Wittenberg is actually a nice city 😃 Wittenbergi? ah Witti, cool name agree, and Wittenberg is also historical, subsuming that Martin Luther lived and worked there ah and he left a paper with 99 thesis at some church door ok witti genesis is in 3 hours and comes with 32 validators each for lighthouse, prysm, and teku if this succeeds, I'll setup bootnodes tomorrow sounds good 👍 thanks <@!557201004060213248> which version of lighthouse to take/use ? the yesterdays released or some more actual tree i am not aware of? looking at https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/branches/active I'm always working off master nice 2 know did it succeed? i guess so, specs are out genesis has gone through but only for witti-testnet ou I'm only seeing 66 of 94 validators required for witti genesis at the moment. oooo, I may have just found why... Looks like there are enough deposits but some were invalid. which were? the first 32 are lh, the next 32 are pryms, and the last 32 are teku https://gist.github.com/ajsutton/8e03db5aea6e094d16333a7a0a0e5e39 is the list of invalid deposits I get. 32-63 mostly. Plus 96. 32 - 63 is prysm. 96 is not my deposit My local lighthouse doesn't appear to have reached genesis either but I don't know if it's waiting for min genesis time or more validators (it says it's reached the minimum deposit count but that's not the same as minimum number of validators). I moved min genesis time to tomorrow morning (EU time) so I can observe it at the office Just double checking we generate the right genesis for schlesi but I don't think anything has changed in our deposit validation lately and it definitely used to work. what exactly is invalid? The signature is really the only thing that can be invalid. Yeah, that's exactly what we're failing on. there is a small chance I used an outdated prysm binary to generate these deposits bazel is a mess I can check once I'm back at the office I'm still digging in to verify that teku isn't rejecting them incorrectly. The ref tests pass but maybe there's something about this configuration we're not picking up. Or too new, v012 is scheduled to change BLS. You may want to double check with <@!399309815517544451> what you're running. BLS hasn't been updated yet for any branch in prysm so the v0.12 branch still has draft 05 was there any recent change that could cause invalid signatures? not that i know of, did the fork version change? yes that is probably the issue then, i believe the fork version is hard coded in the tool I used this https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/5905/files#diff-e719a14f6331f256fc33f4d7f9356379R243 unless maybe you're overriding it somehow oh ok i see, should be fine then but maybe I messed this up ok, I'm pretty sure I did I'll check that first thing in the morning Confirmed that Teku is still accepting the Schlesi deposits and generating the right genesis. If I use the Schlesi config with the Witti deposit contract Teku rejects the lighthouse deposits and accepts the Prysm ones which supports the theory that the Prysm deposits are using a genesis fork of 0, not the witti config.
